d: Deep teal, medium-length hair is styled in messy layers with long, stray strands framing the face and a single high antenna-like lock. A silver, insectoid mask with multiple faceted lenses obscures the eyes and upper face of a youthful, slender figure. The attire consists of a minimal black technical outfit with straps and a high collar, partially obscured by a black rectangular sign held in front of the torso featuring white handwritten text. Spiky, organic black chitinous armor pieces emerge from the back and wrap around the legs like segmented boots, complemented by black fingerless gloves and a black belt. BODY COLOR: pale ivory LEGS: plantigrade, encased in pointed black armor.
